body:
I've done many addictive drugs(coke,oxys,speed..etc) and have never got addicted to any of them, but the hardest one to fend off was dilaudid.
I can score the 8mg I.R pills for 2 bucks(great deal...usually it's 10 bucks for a 4mg) and I started taking just 2 mg's-good starting dose-, then 4 and soon I was up to over 24 mg's each time just to feel it....It comes on fast when I snort it. My hands get clamy, I start to sweat, my pupils shrink to the size of pin heads. And I feel like your king of the world.
It's a fun buzz, but I build a tolerance too fast (I was up to 16mg in two days) I quit doing them but my god they're amazing.
They dont last aslong as oxycontins but they are alot more euphoric and less sedating. Everyone seems to puke on them though.
